rationale: The DE half fits the design: DESeq2 ~condition with vehicle relevelled as reference, Wald test, BH padj, apeglm shrinkage on the reported fold change, a stated low-count heuristic, and sample-ID verification. The activity half is only partly right: it runs ulm per sample on VST with limma (the reference's consistency check) but never runs the primary contrast-level ulm on the unshrunken Wald statistic, replacing it with an ad hoc concordant-target count in Step 4; the plan does at least avoid feeding the apeglm fold change into decoupleR and keeps mor and a regulon size of five. QC lacks a sample distance heatmap and any explicit outlier or shallow-sample policy, and in-model normalization is assumed rather than stated. The added WikiPathways enrichment is well specified (named version, explicit universe, 10-500 window) but ranks fgsea on shrunk log2FC rather than the test statistic, and reporting is decent on versions, design and caveats but does not describe the final side-by-side report or the estimator/input statistic fields explicitly.
